#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <iomanip>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>

using namespace std;

struct Vec {
    static constexpr double EPS = 1e-9;
    double x, y;
    Vec(double x_=0, double y_=0) : x(x_), y(y_) {}
    Vec add(const Vec& o) const { return Vec(x + o.x, y + o.y); }
    Vec sub(const Vec& o) const { return Vec(x - o.x, y - o.y); }
    Vec scale(double s) const { return Vec(x * s, y * s); }
    double dot(const Vec& o) const { return x * o.x + y * o.y; }
    double cross(const Vec& o) const { return x * o.y - y * o.x; }
    double mag2() const { return dot(*this); }
    double mag() const { return sqrt(mag2()); }
    Vec unit() const { double m = mag(); return m == 0 ? Vec(0,0) : scale(1.0/m); }
    Vec rot90() const { return Vec(-y, x); }
    Vec rot270() const { return Vec(y, -x); }
    Vec rotate(double theta) const {
        const double PI = M_PI;
        double newX = x * cos(theta) + y * cos(PI/2 + theta);
        double newY = x * sin(theta) + y * sin(PI/2 + theta);
        return Vec(newX, newY);
    }
    double angle() const {
        return (atan2(y, x) + 2 * M_PI) : fmod(atan2(y, x) + 2 * M_PI, 2 * M_PI);
    }
    string toString() const {
        ostringstream oss;
        oss << "(" << fixed << setprecision(2) << x << ", " << y << ")";
        return oss.str();
    }
    bool equals(const Vec& o) const {
        return fabs(x - o.x) < EPS && fabs(y - o.y) < EPS;
    }
    static bool eq(double a, double b) { return fabs(a - b) < EPS; }
    static bool leq(double a, double b) { return a - EPS <= b; }
    static bool geq(double a, double b) { return a + EPS >= b; }
};

struct Circle {
    Vec c;
    double r;
    Circle(const Vec& c_, double r_) : c(c_), r(r_) {}
    bool contains(const Vec& v) const {
        return Vec::leq(c.sub(v).mag2(), r * r + Vec::EPS * Vec::EPS);
    }
    vector<Vec> intersect(const Circle& o) const {
        if (c.equals(o.c)) return {};
        Vec dir = o.c.sub(c);
        double d2 = dir.mag2();
        double d = sqrt(d2);
        if (r + o.r < d || fabs(r + o.r - d) < Vec::EPS || fabs(fabs(r - o.r) - d) < Vec::EPS)
            return {};
        if (Vec::eq(r + o.r, d))
            return { c.add(dir.scale(r / d)) };
        if (Vec::eq(o.r + r, d))
            return { c.sub(dir.scale(r / d)) };
        double d1 = (r * r + d2 - o.r * o.r) / (2 * d);
        double h = sqrt(max(0.0, r * r - d1 * d1));
        Vec unitDir = dir.unit();
        Vec rInt = c.add(unitDir.scale(d1)).add(unitDir.rot270().scale(h));
        Vec lInt = c.add(unitDir.scale(d1)).add(unitDir.rot90().scale(h));
        return { rInt, lInt };
    }
};

struct FS {
    istringstream in;
    string token;
    FS() {}
    void setInput(istream& str) {
        string line;
        getline(str, line);
        in.str(line);
        in.clear();
    }
    string next() {
        while (!(in >> token)) {
            string line;
            if (!getline(cin, line)) return "";
            in.clear();
            in.str(line);
        }
        return token;
    }
    int nextInt() { return stoi(next()); }
};

int main() {
    FS in;
    in.setInput(cin);
    int n = in.nextInt();
    vector<Circle> circ(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int x = in.nextInt();
        int y = in.nextInt();
        int r = in.nextInt();
        circ[i] = Circle(Vec(x, y), r);
    }
    vector<Vec> points;
    vector<int> par(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) par[i] = i;
    int res = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        vector<Vec> points2;
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            if (i == j) continue;
            vector<Vec> arr = circ[i].intersect(circ[j]);
            if (arr.empty()) continue;
            int a = par[i] = par[par[i]];
            int b = par[j] = par[par[j]];
            par[a] = b;
            for (auto& e : arr) {
                bool found = false;
                for (auto& e2 : points2) {
                    if (e.equals(e2)) { found = true; break; }
                }
                if (!found) points2.push_back(e);
            }
        }
        res += (int)points2.size();
        for (auto& e : points2) {
            bool found = false;
            for (auto& e2 : points) {
                if (e.equals(e2)) { found = true; break; }
            }
            if (!found) points.push_back(e);
        }
    }
    res -= (int)points.size();
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        res += 1 - abs(i - par[i]);
    }
    cout << res << "\n";
    return 0;
}
